classification.difficultyReason: Recover an unknown intersection from inclusive totals before calculating the other regions.

content.prompt:
Solve this problem by drawing a Venn diagram.

The Republican Zoo has a collection of 70 interesting snakes. Fifty-five of them are poisonous, 45 are more than one metre long, and 67 are either poisonous or more than one metre long.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many are poisonous and more than one metre long?

answer.short:
33 snakes.

The overlap is the sum of the set totals minus the union.
answer.worked:
Let $P$ represent poisonous snakes and $L$ snakes more than one metre long. The overlap is counted twice in the sum of the set totals.
$$\begin{align*}|P\cap L|&=55+45-67\\|P\cap L|&=33\end{align*}$$
Put 33 in the overlap.
